articleTitle: Non-linear analysis of an active peak detector
publicationTitle: Nineteeth Asilomar Conference on Circuits, Systems and Computers, 1985.
abstract: The transient response of an active peak detector is analyzed assuming appropriate non-linearites for the drive amplifier and coupling diode, as well as dynamics for the capacitive load and the amplifier's gain - bandwidth. A piecewise linear model development is compared to the quasi-exact solution of the describing non-linear differential equation. The results show that the piecewise linear model predicts an underdamped clamped response to a step, whereas the quasi-exact response shows monotonic behavior. The discrepancy is explained on the basis of a gradual change in the coupling diode's impedance as peak detection occurs in reality versus a ficticious abrupt change in the diode impedance as assumed for the linear piecewise model.

articleTitle: Singular system - A tutorial
publicationTitle: Nineteeth Asilomar Conference on Circuits, Systems and Computers, 1985.
abstract: This paper presents an overview of the theory of singular systems. Conditions for existence and uniqueness of solutions are presented along with techniques for generating solutions. The concepts (unique to these systems) of infinite eigenvalues, modes at infinity, controllability at infinity, and observability at infinity are discussed.
